summary: The victim completed small successful USDT trades before sending larger cash deposits directly to a scammer who delayed payment with fabricated excuses. A second scammer demanded additional funds to release the promised USDT resulting in further losses through an off platform P2P trading scheme.
user_mistake: Trusted repeated successful off platform trades and sent large cash deposits without escrow.
prevention: Use platform escrow for every P2P trade / Stop trading after off platform payment requests
